# Shubham Rao — cshubhamrao.dev

> Senior Software Engineer building platform backends: APIs, infrastructure, reliability.

## Snapshot

- Senior SWE, Core Platform @ **Lyric.tech** — TypeScript services for supply-chain workflows and data APIs.
- Previously at **Tune AI (NimbleBox.ai)** — designed a gRPC backbone that serves **100M+ tokens/day**, trimmed latency by **40%**, and led OpenTelemetry adoption.
- Visiting student at **UC Berkeley SCET (Data-X)** on a scholarship; built Docker Hub analytics pipelines and hit Bay Area hackathons.
- Winner, **IIIT-Delhi HACKIIITD 2017** — blockchain-based misinformation detector built under pressure.
- Talked about **Apache APISIX** and reverse proxying high-volume inference traffic at **DevOpsDays Bengaluru 2023**.

## Skills & Stack

- **Languages**: Go, Python, TypeScript, SQL
- **Backend**: gRPC + Protocol Buffers, REST/FastAPI, Apache APISIX
- **Infrastructure**: Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, GCP, Kafka, RabbitMQ
- **Observability**: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, structured logging
